topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-A-01 — Listening comprehension of Punjabi prose and poetry

outcomes.text: Listen to Punjabi prose and poetry, understanding literal, idiomatic, historical, cultural, social, and global meanings.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-A-02 — Contextual explanation of Punjabi literary texts

outcomes.text: Explain Punjabi literary texts within their historical, cultural, social, and global contexts.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-A-03 — Critical assessment of writers’ and poets’ style and ideas

outcomes.text: Assess a Punjabi writer’s or poet’s style, personality, and ideas.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-A-04 — Literary techniques and their effects

outcomes.text: Identify literary techniques in different works and evaluate their effects.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-A-05 — Artistic and intellectual evaluation of literary works

outcomes.text: Evaluate artistic and intellectual aspects of literary works through audio, video, conversation, and other presentations.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-B-01 — Appropriate spoken use of Punjabi prose and poetry

outcomes.text: Use Punjabi prose and poetry appropriately in speech, explaining idiomatic and technical meanings with reasons.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-B-08 — Creative expression through drama, conversation, and poetry recitation

outcomes.text: Express creativity through drama, conversation, or poetry recitation and present positive views of others’ work.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-C-03 — Writers’ styles, structures, innovations, and movements

outcomes.text: Understand a writer’s style, structure, new experiments, and movements while answering questions about prose and poetry.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-C-04 — Literature and everyday life

outcomes.text: Relate literature to everyday life and recognize its relevance.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-C-05 — Knowledge from literary and non-literary prose and poetry

outcomes.text: Gain knowledge from literary and non-literary prose and poetry and apply it appropriately.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-C-06 — Reading texts for specific purposes

outcomes.text: Read selected texts for different purposes and extract the information needed for those purposes.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-C-10 — Close reading, main points, and relevant references

outcomes.text: Read a text closely, identify its main points, and discuss relevant references.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-C-12 — Writers, poets, and historical backgrounds

outcomes.text: Read works by different writers and poets, understand their historical background, and discuss their contemporary importance.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-C-13 — Critical responses supported by textual evidence

outcomes.text: Read prose or poetry and write a critical response supported by relevant textual evidence.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-C-14 — Comparison of prose and poetry

outcomes.text: Compare prose and poetry texts and explain their similarities and differences.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-C-15 — Global issues and personal solutions

outcomes.text: Identify major global issues in different texts and suggest personal solutions.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-C-16 — World cultures and social connections through texts

outcomes.text: Learn about different world cultures through texts and connect them with social and economic relationships.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-C-17 — Dialogue in novels and stories

outcomes.text: Understand dialogue in novels and stories and connect it meaningfully with the text.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-C-18 — Principles and methods of critical reading

outcomes.text: Read Punjabi-related material and understand the principles and methods of critical analysis.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-C-19 — Grammar in reading prose and poetry

outcomes.text: Apply grammatical principles while reading prose and poetry.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-C-20 — Understanding and expressing viewpoints

outcomes.text: Understand others’ ideas and viewpoints while reading prose and poetry, then explain the text.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-D-03 — Poets’ literary qualities and poetic background

outcomes.text: Describe a poet’s literary qualities in relation to the background of the poetry.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-D-04 — Critical and aesthetic analysis of prose and poetry

outcomes.text: Write a critical and aesthetic analysis of any prose or poetic work.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-D-05 — Personal views on central themes

outcomes.text: Express personal views and ideas about the central theme of a prose or poetic work.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-D-06 — Translation into idiomatic Punjabi

outcomes.text: Translate any text into idiomatic Punjabi using appropriate translation techniques and digital tools.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-D-07 — Literary and non-literary essays

outcomes.text: Write a well-supported essay on any literary or non-literary topic.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-D-08 — Adaptation of drama and prose into scripts or films

outcomes.text: Adapt a drama or prose work into a script or film format.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-D-09 — Travelogues, features, and informational reports

outcomes.text: Write a complete travelogue, feature, or informational report using appropriate technical conventions.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-D-10 — Critical analysis of formal and informal writing

outcomes.text: Understand details in formal and informal writing and present an independent critical evaluation.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-D-11 — Summarizing lengthy Punjabi texts

outcomes.text: Summarize any Punjabi lengthy text according to its content.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-D-12 — Critical responses to poetic extracts

outcomes.text: Write a critical response to poetic extracts.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-E-03 — Word combinations and their effects

outcomes.text: Identify word combinations in literary texts and evaluate their effects.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-E-04 — Paronomasia and its effects

outcomes.text: Explain meanings and effects created by paronomasia in prose and poetry.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-E-06 — Poetic genres and the poet’s selection

outcomes.text: Recognize poetic genres and evaluate the writer’s selection and their effects.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-E-09 — Thematic and structural varieties of poetry

outcomes.text: Recognize thematic and structural varieties of poetry and explain their features.

topics.title: SLO:Pun-11-E-10 — Literary devices and their effects

outcomes.text: Identify literary devices in prose and poetry, evaluate their effects, and use them in writing.
